sections.name: SegmentChip
sections.title: Segment filter pill
sections.what: Shows the active segment in a dark pill with a clear button.
sections.why: Tells users the view is narrowed and gives a one-click reset.
sections.watch_out: The segment name is shown as given, so long names can stretch the pill.

summary: A dark pill showing the active segment filter, with an x button to clear it.
purpose: Shows the user that the view is narrowed to one segment, and lets them undo it.
why: Stated in the code comment: one click returns to the All state.
how: Shows the segment name and a clear button that calls the clear handler.
inputs: The segment name and a clear handler.
outputs: A pill with a clear button.
risks: If the clear handler does nothing, the filter stays on.
debug: If clearing does nothing, check the parent's clear handler.
